source.note: Built from the git tag (no release tarball exists). The binary reports itself as "AutoTrace version 0.40.0".

build.flag_reason: GCC 15 rejects an old pointer-type mismatch in the BMP reader (src/input-bmp.c). The flag turns that error back into a warning; the benchmark reads PNG only.
build.input_formats_built: ppm, pbm, pnm, png, tga, bmp, pgm, gf (no ImageMagick/GraphicsMagick readers)

other_options: tool defaults: corner-threshold 100, corner-always-threshold 60, corner-surround 4, error-threshold 2.0, filter-iterations 4, line-threshold 1, line-reversion-threshold 0.01, noise-removal 0.99, despeckle-level 0; outline (fill) output, no centerline, no background-color, no thresholding step
configuration_rationale: One configuration, chosen before any scoring run. Plain defaults on an antialiased input traced every grey level as its own region (about 700 paths with grey fills on a Fonts and an Icons input, 3-image unscored check), so the single-ink setting -color-count 2 was used. No other setting was tried or compared and no result was used to select it.
input_conversion: input.png (the same 256 px file Monotrace and VTracer receive) alpha-composited onto white and saved as RGB PNG (autotrace-input.png). A pixel no-op for Fonts and Icons (alpha is 255 everywhere); required for PolyFit, whose inputs carry the shape in the alpha channel and which AutoTrace would otherwise read as a black block.
output_note: AutoTrace emits a white background path plus a near-black ink path (fill about #030303); both are rendered as written. Segment counts therefore include the background path. The near-black ink fill is not pure black.
script_changes: Generalized the VTracer-only script: --engine vtracer|autotrace, --corpus fonts|icons|polyfit, an always-on hash verification of every case against the frozen manifest (abort on mismatch), an autotrace runner, a PolyFit scoring path (reference = input raster at native width, scale 1, as benchmark_external.score does for the pilot, no DINO), and IoU pairing counts. VTracer behaviour is unchanged.

dino_settings.features: reference features reused from the frozen runs' cache (same context hash: weights, processor, dtype); AutoTrace features computed fresh. Earlier runs used different thread/batch settings (VTracer Fonts: 8 threads, batch 16; Icons main run: 4 threads, batch 8).

timing: Subprocess call time in a thread pool; informational only, not a speed comparison.
scope: The 116 PolyFit binary inputs (58 artworks at two labelled sizes) of the pilot manifest
pairing_evidence: benchmarks/external_pilot_20261104 (results.csv) read-only; Monotrace, Potrace and VTracer were NOT re-run. No DINO score exists for PolyFit.
scoring: No ground-truth vector exists: the reference is the input raster itself, rendered at native width (scale 1) as in the pilot. This measures fidelity to the thresholded raster, not contour quality.
case_integrity: Every case's source (where one exists) and 256 px input hashes were verified against the frozen manifest before tracing; any mismatch aborts the run.
